title: Completed affine formal comparison model
statement: For a Noetherian scheme Y, proper f : X ⟶ Y, ideals J K, formal system G, coherent F, comparison data satisfying the quotient and adjunction equations, and an affine U, writing B = Γ(Y,U), R = AdicCompletion (J.ideal U) B and L = (K.ideal U).map (algebraMap B R), there exist coherent modules A,D over Spec R and c : A.obj ⟶ D.obj, invertible after restricting away from V(L), together with scalar-restriction isomorphisms eA,eD identifying the affine limits and making the comparison square commute.

source.place: Lemma 30.25.3 (088B), proof after reduction to an affine completed base

proof.text: Restrict to U=Spec B. The equations uniquely characterize kappa and alpha: quotient projections are epimorphisms, lim kappa is invertible by formal functions, and the affine equivalence is fully faithful.

Base change to the J-adic completion B-prime. It is flat and Noetherian; quotients by J^n are unchanged. Degree-zero flat base change identifies the pushed quotient maps and adjunction units. Uniqueness identifies the comparison after base change. The equivalence on J-power-torsion modules identifies every term and its transition maps, hence the inverse-limit maps before and after completion.

Over the complete affine base the affine equivalence algebraizes G. Compatibility of tensor pullback with completion and coherence of the pullback allow full faithfulness of completion over the proper source to algebraize beta to an isomorphism b:f*G->F. The equations identify alpha with the completion of the adjunction map followed by f_*b.

On the completed base the algebraized adjunction map is invertible outside the extended exceptional closed set, since the base changed proper morphism is an isomorphism there. The affine equivalence and completeness of finite modules identify its sections with the two original affine limits, naturally on the comparison map. This produces the stated commuting square; no power-annihilation conclusion is used.

theorem formalComparison_completed_affine_model
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (J K : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (hV : IsIso (pullback.snd f (Scheme.Opens.ι K.support.compl)))
    (adj : Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Y J) (F : CoherentModules X)
    (β : G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj)
    (h : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Y.toRingedSpace
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj))
    (κ : formalCompletionSystem J ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ⟶
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
    (α : G ⟶ (completion Y J).obj ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj, h⟩)
    (hκ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ≫
        κ.app (op n) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
        (formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap f) (n + 1) F.obj))
    (hα : ∀ n : ℕ, α.hom.app (op n) ≫ κ.app (op n) =
      adj.unit.app (G.obj.obj (op n)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (β.hom.app (op n))) :
    ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
      let B := Γ(Y, U.1)
      let R := AdicCompletion (J.ideal U) B
      let L := (K.ideal U).map (algebraMap B R)
      let Q := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
        (L.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom)
      ∃ (A D : CoherentModules (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (c : A.obj ⟶ D.obj),
        IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Scheme.Opens.ι Q.support.compl)).map c) ∧
        ∃ eA : limit (G.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)) ≅
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B R)).obj
              ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj A.obj),
        ∃ eD : limit (((completion Y J).obj
            ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj, h⟩).obj ⋙
              SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)) ≅
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B R)).obj
              ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj D.obj),
          lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
            (SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1))) ≫ eD.hom =
          eA.hom ≫ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B R)).map
            ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map c)
